# fmt
# note where the request ends is visible once the file is formatted: above the
# note status line is made canonical, below it is left alone
>>> f.rr
-- a --
get https://x/ HTTP/1.1
accept:a

HTTP/2.0 204 No Content
x-left: as it is
>>> want f.rr
-- a --
GET https://x/ HTTP/1.1
Accept: a

HTTP/2.0 204 No Content
x-left: as it is
>>> stdout
{{root}}/f.rr
